newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro-MPs want improved EU aid for poorer regions.
newsitem.headline: Euro-MPs want improved EU aid for poorer regions.

text.p: European Union procedures for funding regional development in poorer parts of Italy and Germany are too slow and unwieldy, the European Parliament said on Tuesday.
Euro-MPs adopted two reports on EU aid to Italy and Germany which call for improvements in the EU's structural, regional and social funds.
The reports were drafted for the parliament's regional policy committee by Italian Union for Europe Euro-MP Guido Podesta and German Socialist Gerhard Botz.

In a separate report on a European Commission communication on the EU's cohesion fund and the environment -- COM(95)509 -- parliament said a larger share of the money should be dedicated to nature conservation and protecting endangered species.
The cohesion fund targets the four poorest member states -- Greece, Portugal, Ireland and Spain -- and is split 50-50 between transport and environmental schemes.
